response: Diffusion-weighted echo-planar MR imaging (epiDWI) has the potential to differentiate certain histologic subtypes of primary parotid gland tumors, such as pleomorphic adenoma and myoepithelial adenomas, from other entities. However, due to an overlap in ADC values within and between groups of benign and malignant lesions, diagnoses should not be based solely on ADC values. Therefore, it is recommended that further studies combine diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) with morphologic criteria and possibly other MR imaging techniques to improve the prediction of different histologic subtypes.
